facts.fact: Local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand dollars per airing, according to 2026 guidance from Comcast Advertising and National Media Spots.
facts.value: a few hundred to several thousand dollars
facts.quote: A local TV ad cost usually runs from a few hundred dollars to several thousand per airing.

facts.fact: National Media Spots gives a local broadcast TV range of $500 to $10,000 per month (dated June 13, 2026).
facts.quote: | Local broadcast TV | $500 to $10,000 | Per month |

facts.fact: National Media Spots gives a regional cable TV range of $1,000 to $20,000 per month (dated June 13, 2026).
facts.quote: | Regional cable TV | $1,000 to $20,000 | Per month |

facts.fact: National Media Spots gives a streaming/CTV range of $500 to $50,000+ per month (dated June 13, 2026).
facts.quote: | Streaming/CTV | $500 to $50,000+ | Per month |

facts.fact: National Media Spots gives a streaming/CTV range of $15 to $40+ CPM (dated June 13, 2026).
facts.quote: | Streaming/CTV | $15 to $40+ | CPM |

facts.fact: Amazon Ads gives a TV 30-second spot range of $5 to $30 CPM (date not stated).
facts.quote: | TV, 30-second spot | $5 to $30 | CPM | Amazon Ads |

facts.fact: Per Moonb's 2026 commercial cost guide, citing NBC via Bloomberg, a Super Bowl 30-second spot averages about $8 million for airtime only, with some above $10 million (reported Jan 29, 2026).
facts.value: about $8 million average; some above $10 million
facts.quote: About $8 million average, some above $10 million

facts.fact: National Media Spots says prime time (typically 8 to 11 PM) carries the highest local TV rates, while early morning, daytime and late-night slots cost less.
facts.quote: Prime time (typically 8 to 11 PM) carries the highest rates because viewing peaks then.

facts.fact: Moonb's 2026 guide puts production for a simple local spot at $1,500 to $10,000.
facts.quote: puts a simple local spot at $1,500 to $10,000 for production.

facts.fact: Moonb's 2026 guide puts professional mid-range TV commercial production at $10,000 to $50,000.
facts.quote: Professional mid-range work runs $10,000 to $50,000.

facts.fact: National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.
facts.quote: National Media Spots notes that CTV campaigns can launch on $500 to $1,000 a month.

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services projects total 2026 local ad revenue at $186.1 billion in its September 14, 2026 forecast update; these are forecasts, not measured spending.
facts.quote: projects total 2026 local ad revenue at $186.1 billion

facts.fact: BIA's September 2026 forecast is up $1.6 billion and about 9% above 2025 total local ad revenue.
facts.quote: up $1.6 billion and about 9% above 2025

facts.fact: BIA's April 2026 estimate put total 2026 local ad spend at $184.5 billion.
facts.quote: April 2026 estimate of $184.5 billion

facts.fact: BIA forecasts local political spending at $9.7 billion for 2026, up from $8.4 billion in its April estimate.
facts.quote: local political spending at $9.7 billion for 2026, up from $8.4 billion in April

facts.fact: Of BIA's $1.3 billion increase in 2026 political spending, $1.2 billion is attributed to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming).
facts.quote: BIA says $1.2 billion went to TV OTA (broadcast) and TV OTT (streaming)

facts.fact: BIA's first look at 2027 has political spending falling to about $1.1 billion, with total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion.
facts.quote: political spending falling to about $1.1 billion in the off-cycle year, with total local revenue roughly flat at $186.5 billion

facts.fact: Adwave's own pricing allows daily budgets from $30 to $10,000, prepaid, with no subscription or contract.
facts.quote: Adwave pricing allows [daily budgets from $30 to $10,000](https://adwave.com/pricing/), prepaid, with no subscription or contract

facts.fact: According to Adwave, TV, Facebook, Instagram and Google (YouTube and Search) open from $30 a day.
facts.quote: TV, Facebook, Instagram and Google (YouTube and Search) open from $30 a day.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, Reddit opens from about $35 a day.
facts.quote: Reddit opens from about $35 a day.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, extra creative beyond the included set costs $12 per additional 30-second TV spot.
facts.quote: $12 per additional 30-second TV spot
